prompt: In the Splice project {project}, insert the photo at {photo} as a 3-second still right after the opener, give it a slow Ken Burns zoom from 1x to 1.2x across those 3 seconds, and add an arrow shape on the screen take for about 1.5 seconds. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: still inserted
checks.expr: any(media_kind(c['media']) == 'image' and 80 <= c['length'] <= 100 and abs(c['start'] - 120) <= 2 for c in clips)

checks.name: ken burns
checks.expr: any(media_kind(c['media']) == 'image' and e['type'] == 'transform' and isinstance(e['params'].get('scale'), dict) and max(k['value'] for k in e['params']['scale']['keys']) >= 1.15 for c in clips for e in c['effects'])

checks.name: arrow
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'shape' and i['params'].get('shape') == 'arrow' and 30 <= i['length'] <= 60 for i in items)
